overview.description: The VanEck Real Estate TruSector ETF (TRUR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in real estate equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in equity securities of real estate-related US-listed companies. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation through exposure to industries such as REITs, real estate management and development, and diversified real estate activities. TRUR was launched on Jul 7, 2026 and is issued by VanEck.
